markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (91%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 blurred frozen section with single-class set [F1] and positive margins.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 91%, InSitu 9% | Favors Invasive; ECE 5% |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (alpha 10%) | Single class; 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% / 100% (12/12 regions) [F6] | Unflagged; error AUROC 70% |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree | Independent models match |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (70%–79%) [F5] | Match; InSitu contrast 67% |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 8, 11) · context · High (+1.58), contribution -1.33 (8/20) [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-1.03, +1.27); unreliable (0/20) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-1.35, +1.07); 20/20 check [F4] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Low (-1.34, +0.97); caption-inconsistent (18/20) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; top-3 risk deletion beats random (+0.0114, CI +0.0021 to +0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008, CI -0.0088 to +0.0064); uses unreliable normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Frozen-section blur (severity 3) masks architecture; reliability AUROC is 70%, cells disabled, stains blocked.
- InSitu (9%; contrast BACH_0063, 67% similarity) mimics invasion or inflates positive margin calls.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 1, 4, 6**: Highest risk (96%–100%); confirm invasion despite severity-3 blur.
2. **Regions 5, 11**: Check stroma, tubules, and duct-confined atypia vs InSitu BACH_0063.
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11**: Verify tumor at inferior, superior, medial, lateral margins (753, 430, 323, 215 um) [F7].
